successor_acceptance_artifact_policy: A successor acceptance artifact issuing before arm REQUIRES pack regeneration (packs are unfrozen drafts; the D-125 lineage-envelope alternative is recorded as a freeze-time lead decision).

transfer_assumption.statement: Within one authenticated ABBA calibration bracket, onset and offset fiducial terms are shared edges while bundle-specific residual terms remain adversarial.

stationarity_transfer_assumption.statement: The shared onset and offset edge treatment calibrated on floor blocks transfers unchanged to the consuming contrast at the same block timescale.
stationarity_transfer_assumption.evidentiary_limit: The historical corpus records bounds, not realized member-level boundary errors.
